title: Rune Technologies Joins Project Dynamis to Deliver Predictive Logistics for the Marine Corps
summary: Rune Technologies develops autonomous resupply solutions for military logistics.
body_markdown:
# Autonomous Resupply Innovations


Rune Technologies is pioneering autonomous resupply solutions aimed at enhancing military logistics. These innovations are designed to ensure that troops receive essential supplies without delay, even in challenging environments.


> "Our autonomous systems will change the way logistics are managed in the field," said a Rune Technologies representative.


This initiative is expected to significantly improve the efficiency and effectiveness of military operations.
